_doc: Allowed differences from the baseline (check 1), each exact. An entry matches a difference when every field it gives matches: check, kind (pageAdded|pageRemoved|changed|added|removed), field (page|title|h1|description|canonical|robots|ads|rm|pct|phones|jsonld), url and path (regex), value (regex on the difference text), old/new (exact sides of a change; null = absent), values (exact list of added/removed values). Figures are compared by value (ranges keep both ends; K/ribu/juta/bilion expanded). Not listed here because the check derives them: NCD figures computed from car-models.json with the site helpers, and FAQ wording edits that equal the visible FAQ and carry the same figures. Every entry needs a reason. See docs/checks.md.
